# Wildlife model credits

These authored models are redistributed with the Maeul in the Sky tour. Their Creative Commons licenses are separate from the project's software license. The original creators did not endorse this project.

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Squirrel | **Chipmunk**, Poly by Google, model `fQ5KzXoR2uA` | [Original model](https://poly.pizza/m/fQ5KzXoR2uA) | [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/) |
| Cow | **Cow**, Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animals | [Creator's pack](https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html) | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |

| Horse | **Horse**, Quaternius, Ultimate Animated Animals | [Creator's pack](https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html) | [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) |

Modifications by the Maeul in the Sky contributors: repacked the original models into self-contained GLB files; removed unused resources; retained the listed peaceful idle/eating animations; consolidated Quaternius solid materials into vertex colors and one drawable primitive while preserving the original colors, silhouette, rig, joint weights, and transforms. Redundant animation keys were removed without approximation. The chipmunk retains its original texture and is not rigged; it has no authored animation clips. The tour may apply separate, subtle ambient motion at runtime.

The five Ultimate Animated Animals models were downloaded from the creator's original glTF folder. The original pack's [CC0 notice](licenses/Quaternius-ultimate-pack.txt) is preserved here. This inventory uses those historical CC0 downloads, not a newly licensed asset pack. Quaternius also published the [farm pack on OpenGameArt in 2018 with CC0](https://opengameart.org/content/lowpoly-animated-farm-animal-pack).

Full license texts: [CC BY 3.0](licenses/CC-BY-3.0.txt), [CC0 1.0](licenses/CC0-1.0.txt). Exact source download URLs, original and modified SHA-256 digests, per-file measurements, and retained clip names are recorded in [manifest.json](manifest.json).
